proposal.description: The step-window counter wraps on any clock that finds it at its terminal count, not only on a switching-cycle boundary, so it never waits at the terminal count for the PWM falling edge that should end the window.
proposal.reason: When cycles_per_step > 1 (the default is 16), the counter reaches the terminal count on one PWM falling edge and wraps on the very next clock. The ceiling-step test needs pwm_fall and the terminal count on the same clock, so it never fires: max_on_counts stays at the MIN_ON_COUNTS floor for all of S_SS, and SS_done never rises unless max_on_limit equals the floor.

proposal.description: The ramp stops on the latched SS_done flag instead of on the live ceiling-vs-max_on_limit comparison, so the at-target clamp acts only after the look-ahead has already finished the ramp.
proposal.reason: If max_on_limit equals the floor, the ramp should finish on the first clock of S_SS. Under the mutant it steps to floor+1, the look-ahead never matches, and the ceiling climbs and wraps with SS_done never asserted. If max_on_limit is lowered below the ceiling during the ramp, the ceiling is not clamped and keeps climbing past the new limit.
